scenes.text: Imagine waking up at 1:00 AM every single night, not from a nightmare, but because your body was programmed to do it.
Centuries ago, humans didn't sleep in one block, but instead had two distinct sleep periods separated by an active midnight hour.
When modern electricity arrived, it completely destroyed this natural biological rhythm, forcing us into the single eight-hour cycle we struggle with today.
Would you prefer to go back to this ancient two-sleep system? Tell us in the comments and follow for more.
